unit_id.description: Echo the unit_id exactly as supplied. Do not alter it.

scores_full_breakdown.description: Independent ordinal intensity score for each of the six themes. Themes do not compete; a unit may score 3 on more than one.

binding_status.description: Legal force of the highest-scoring theme's mechanism in this unit, independent of its intensity score. 'n/a' only when all six themes score 0.

score3_evidence.description: Populate whenever any theme scores 3, or when exactly two of the three conditions are met (the near-miss that caps a theme at 2). Otherwise all three fields are null.

instrument.description: Quoted operative language identifying the legal, regulatory or executive instrument. Null if absent.

addressee.description: The specified party placed under obligation. Null if absent.

consequence.description: The penalty, sanction, audit, exclusion, or explicit override of an otherwise-applicable legal requirement. Null if absent.

justification.description: 2-4 sentences. Cite the operative verbs in the text and name the codebook rule or anchor applied. State which of the three Score-3 conditions were found whenever any theme scores 3 or is capped at 2 by the Evidence Test.
